messages:
Maya: dropped a compact 'signature pill' mock for run history that combines name, latency, and an example badge. figma: https://figma.redwood/compact-pill-v1 :mag:
Rohan: looks promising. main concerns: keyboard access, SR summary, and hover-only actions.
Elise: SR suggestion: announce as 'Tool call: <name>, collapsed, X fields, has examples' when focused. keep it short.
Maya: thinking header copy: 'translate_snippet \u00b7 28ms' — middle dot for density?
Tom: middle dot is good. for very long names ellipsize and show full name in tooltip + sr-only announcement on focus.
Rohan: interaction pattern: Tab lands on the card container, Enter toggles expansion, Arrow keys move between cards. Esc collapses and returns focus. consistent with other lists.
Elise: accessibility nit: 'Copy signature' must be keyboard reachable, not hover-only. implement a focusable sr-only button that becomes visible on keyboard focus.
Maya: added tiny JSON preview in the mock:
```json
{"name":"translate_snippet","params":{"text":"Salut","target_lang":"en"}}
```
Tom: layout idea: line1 = signature pill + :page_facing_up: badge if examples; line2 = truncated first field; meta row tiny (type | token_count | ms).
Rohan: microcopy: expand action should be 'View full output' not 'Expand schema' — clearer for product folks. also use aria-expanded.
Elise: visual nudge: bump header weight + color to hit 4.5:1 contrast. ops wanted 44px rows, design 56px. propose 50px compromise and test keyboard outlines.
Maya: agreed on 50px for initial testing. also will use a 3px focus ring that's visible at small sizes.
Tom: small perf note: when collapsed, render only truncated fields to keep list fast; render full schema on demand.
figma-bot: Uploaded: https://figma.redwood/compact-pill-v1 (v2) — comments resolved.
Maya: thanks! I'll iterate and drop updated PNGs tomorrow. :party-parrot:
